conceptual_delta: Connect five existing research tracks to reusable evidence-record shapes and cross-record audits without adding observed model results or changing prior plans.

initial_findings_and_repairs.finding: Initial draft conflated common fields with learning-only revision fields and missed subtype Core application.
initial_findings_and_repairs.repair: Shared Common shape plus six separate record subtype shapes; LOCAL/READ do not require learning revision records.

initial_findings_and_repairs.finding: Initial missing-outcome negative probe returned zero rows because FILTER NOT EXISTS was inside a UNION branch while record binding was outside that branch.
initial_findings_and_repairs.repair: Each audit branch binds the record locally. The missing-outcome and other query probes now detect violations.

initial_findings_and_repairs.finding: Hashes of distinct split manifests alone do not establish disjoint evaluation membership.
initial_findings_and_repairs.repair: Audit compares declared world/case membership in FINAL versus SEARCH/SELECTION/CALIBRATION under the same protocol.

initial_findings_and_repairs.finding: Unknown validation subtypes and orphan support records could evade subtype checks.
initial_findings_and_repairs.repair: Added supported-role and reverse-reference audits plus negative probes.

hswm_dev.task: Engineer five HSWM experiment evidence contracts with standard graph validation and explicit skill provenance

workspace.historical_workspace_snapshot_policy: Earlier source-bound workspace and plan bytes preserved; its former manifest binding may differ from current manifest, as expected for a new revision.

limitations: Synthetic declared-record checks only; not actual model experiments or efficacy.
Hash syntax and links do not authenticate external source bytes or independence.
Split audit compares declared world/case membership; it cannot detect undeclared semantic duplicates or hidden training exposure.
Required cost component coverage and measurement status do not prove complete counters or equal actual compute.
Arm labels, probability/tuple and scale digests are contracts; no complete experiment-arm census, normalized joint-law proof, or parent learning is established.
Model/server/tokenizer pin strings are required but external identities and artifacts are not resolved.
